Name: Yoba's Altar
Author: xixifu
Description:
[center][size=4]MineBustle - 由巴的祭坛[/size][/center]
MineBustle - 由巴的祭坛 通过一座献给由巴的神秘祭坛，为星露谷物语的矿井带来全新的动态挑战系统。

🎮 核心功能
由巴的祭坛 位于矿井入口，这座神圣的祭坛允许你献祭金币以换取怪物生成倍率的提升。祭坛拥有直观的滑块界面，你可以选择从 1.0x（正常）到 10.0x（极限混乱）的任意倍率。
动态定价系统 献祭费用基于以下因素智能计算：
[list]
[*]基础费用：任何献祭的起始成本（默认：500金币）
[*]通胀系数：根据你的终身总收入缩放，确保挑战在整个游戏过程中保持相关性
[*]惩罚指数：高倍率的指数级费用增长，使极限挑战真正昂贵
[/list]智能石头减少 启用可选的石头减少功能，确保怪物在高倍率下有足够的生成空间。否则，石头生成可能会挤占怪物，导致你无法达到完整的挑战潜力。
每日重置 怪物倍率每天重置，让你可以根据当前目标和资源选择挑战等级。

⚙️ 高度可配置 所有参数都可以通过 Generic Mod Config Menu 调整：
[list]
[*]启用/禁用祭坛
[*]调整基础费用（0-10,000金币）
[*]微调通胀系数（0-0.001）
[*]修改惩罚指数（1.0-3.0）
[*]切换石头生成减少
[/list]支持英文、中文、日语。

[line][center][size=4]MineBustle - Yoba's Altar[/size][/center]
MineBustle - Yoba's Altar brings a new dynamic challenge system to Stardew Valley's mines through a mysterious altar dedicated to Yoba.

🎮 Core Features
Yoba's Altar Located at the mine entrance, this sacred altar allows you to offer gold in exchange for increased monster spawns. The altar features an intuitive slider interface where you can choose your desired multiplier from 1.0x (normal) to 10.0x (extreme chaos).
Dynamic Pricing System The cost of offerings scales intelligently based on:
[list]
[*]Base Fee: Starting cost for any offering (default: 500g)
[*]Inflation Coefficient: Scales with your total lifetime earnings, ensuring the challenge remains relevant throughout your playthrough
[*]Penalty Exponent: Exponential cost increase for higher multipliers, making extreme challenges truly expensive
[/list]Smart Stone Reduction Enable the optional stone reduction feature to ensure monsters have room to spawn at high multipliers. Without this, stone generation can crowd out monsters, preventing you from achieving the full challenge potential.
Daily Reset Monster multipliers reset each day, allowing you to choose your challenge level based on your current goals and resources.

⚙️ Highly Configurable All parameters can be adjusted via Generic Mod Config Menu:
[list]
[*]Enable/disable the altar
[*]Adjust base fee (0-10,000g)
[*]Fine-tune inflation coefficient (0-0.001)
[*]Modify penalty exponent (1.0-3.0)
[*]Toggle stone spawn reduction
[/list]Supports English, Chinese, and Japanese.
